T: Adventure is out there. So is dessert.
D: A grumpy widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies to South America, with a young stowaway.
P: Serve dessert when Carl and Russell sit on the kerb with their ice creams.
S: the grape soda cap badge Ellie gives Carl
Grape juice set with gelatine in little round moulds, turned out and topped with a dot of whipped cream so they look like bottle caps.
Wilderness Explorer honey trail mix bars

Chewy oat bars packed with peanuts, sultanas, banana chips and chocolate chips, bound with honey and peanut butter and cut into badge-sized squares. Heat the oven to 170C and line a 20 x 30cm tin. Toast 250g rolled oats for 10 minutes. Warm 150g honey, 120g peanut butter and 60g butter until smooth. Stir in the oats, 80g roasted peanuts, 80g sultanas and 50g crushed banana chips, cool for 10 minutes, then fold in 80g chocolate chips. Press firmly into the tin and bake for 15 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into squares.
the house floating on thousands of balloons

Light, puffy choux balls with sharp cheddar and a little mustard baked in, crisp outside and hollow inside, served warm by the bunch. Heat the oven to 200C. Bring 125ml water, 125ml milk, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil. Tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes until it leaves the pan. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated cheddar and 1 tsp Dijon. Pipe 30 small balls on lined trays, top with a little more cheese and bake for 22 minutes until puffed and golden.
M: the explorer's dinner, served by his dogs
Beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C, rested, carved, with a red wine sauce, roast potatoes and buttered greens, a very proper dinner in the clouds.
the South American cliffs Ellie always wanted to see

Crisp golden corn arepas split open and stuffed with shredded chicken and avocado salad, with grated cheese and a fresh green coriander sauce. Poach 600g chicken breast for 15 minutes and shred. Mix with 1 mashed avocado, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, lime juice, coriander and salt. Mix 300g pre-cooked white corn flour with 450ml warm water and 1 tsp salt, rest 5 minutes and shape 8 discs 1.5cm thick. Cook in an oiled pan over medium heat for 6 minutes a side until crisp. Blend coriander, 1 green chilli, garlic, lime and 80ml oil for the sauce. Split the arepas and fill.
W: the giant bird who loves chocolate
Dark chocolate bark scattered with toasted hazelnuts, dried cherries and flaky salt, set and broken into shards. Save some for the bird.
K: Ellie's club drink, the grape soda cap badge

Purple grape juice and soda poured over scoops of vanilla ice cream so it fizzes up, with a straw, a long spoon and a few frozen grapes. Freeze 100g red grapes for 2 hours. Mix 600ml purple grape juice with 400ml chilled soda water and a squeeze of lime. Put 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses, then pour the grape soda over slowly so it foams up. Drop in a few frozen grapes and serve with a straw and a long spoon.

s.note: the grape soda cap badge Ellie gives Carl
s.how: Soak 6 gelatine leaves. Warm 500ml grape juice with 2 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon and stir in the gelatine. Set in small round moulds for 3 hours. Turn out and top each with a dot of whipped cream.

m.note: the explorer's dinner, served by his dogs
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg sirloin at 200C to 52C and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml stock and whisk in a knob of butter. Steam 300g green beans and toss in butter.

w.note: the giant bird who loves chocolate
w.how: Melt 300g dark chocolate and spread thin on a lined tray. Scatter with 60g toasted hazelnuts, 60g dried cherries and flaky salt. Set and break into shards. Save some for the bird.
